title: Smiling Toddler Girl in Plaid Dress, 1944 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A delightful black and white studio-style portrait of a smiling young toddler girl sitting happily on a draped surface. She wears a ruffled dress trimmed with plaid fabric along the armholes and skirt hem, complete with dark shoes and light socks. Her hair is styled with a charming top knot. The light casts a soft shadow against the backdrop behind her.
